messages.subject: how to tell rqtl my data is from rils not from bc
parts:
hi,

i used my csv ril data to map QTL, but after i load my data, it shows cross type is bc, what will be the problem.

code is as follows,
library(qtl)

cross <- read.cross("csv", file="D:\\Users\\Administrator\\Desktop\\rqtl MQM mapping\\2.csv",
                      genotypes=c("A","B"),
                      na.strings="
                    -", alleles=c("A","B"))

thanks a lot
ma

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] how to tell rqtl my data is from rils not from bc
parts:
In the call to read.cross, include crosstype=“riself” or crosstype=“risib”

karl
